subject: Convergence partner onboarding: enablement schedule & joint lab plan
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <amira@convergence.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@convergence.ai
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Convergence + Redwood: onboarding plan and enablement materials

Hi Irene and Jonas,

Thanks for the productive conversation at the alliance briefing last week — Convergence Analytics is excited to move forward on the integration and partner enablement plan. We are an analytics ISV focusing on customer insights for retail chains; our professional services team will co-deliver early implementations and we want Redwood to be the recommended inference backend for our solution.

Attached are our proposed SOW and a technical questionnaire that covers current infra, data residency needs, and an initial test dataset. High level ask: can Redwood help run a four-week enablement sprint for our first SI cohort (2 PS consultants + 1 SE)? The sprint should cover:
- joint lab where we test end-to-end flow (ingest -> embeddings -> retrieval -> generation)
- quantization & cost/perf baseline for our sample workloads
- training materials and a 2-hour instructor-led workshop for our consultants

Proposed dates: week of Apr 22 for the lab, Apr 29 for the workshop. Open to adjustments.

Attachments: Convergence_Onboarding_SOW.pdf, Convergence_Technical_Questionnaire.xlsx

Can you confirm availability and next steps?

Best,
Amira Hassan
Head of Alliances, Convergence Analytics
Amira.hassan@convergence.ai

---

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@convergence.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence + Redwood: onboarding plan and enablement materials

Amira — thanks for the SOW and questionnaire. We can absolutely support a four-week enablement sprint and will scope it to balance latency/cost profiling plus hands-on runbooks for your PS team. Quick responses to your items:

- Proposed timeline looks fine; I suggest we treat Apr 22 as "lab week 0" (sandbox prep + baseline runs) and Apr 29 as the instructor-led workshop.
- We'll need 1-2 sample data slices (PII-free) and a short prompt set to drive quality checks. The questionnaire covers this but if you can highlight a representative dataset row count that helps us size GPU profiles.
- I'll attach our Redwood_Enablement_Checklist that lists prerequisites, expected roles, and a recommended mutual action plan template.

Next steps from Redwood:
1) Jonas will draft the lab scope and hardware footprint.
2) Camila will own partner enablement content and coordinate LMS artifacts.
3) I'll send a calendar invite once you confirm the specific attendee list.

Two small asks: can you confirm whether you require a white-labeling clause in collateral, and whether the SOW needs a specific PO number?

Thanks — looking forward to running this together.

— Irene Choi
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_Enablement_Checklist.xlsx

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@convergence.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T08:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence + Redwood: onboarding plan and enablement materials

Amira — quick technical note on the lab scope so we align expectations:

- Lab objective: validate end-to-end inference throughput at representative QPS and measure cost per 1k tokens for both baseline FP16 and int8 quantized runs. We'll run the following experiments: single-shot generation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) with 512-token context, and an embedding batch job to measure embedding throughput.
- Prereqs: a 1000-row sanitized sample (CSV), sample prompt set (10-15 prompts), and example retrieval index (we can ingest a mini-index if you prefer).
- Hardware: recommend a 2-GPU pod (A100 equivalent) for lab day to give headroom; we can provide a cheaper 1-GPU run for cost-model demos.
- Deliverables: lab runbook, perf/cost report, quantization notes, and a short playbook for your PS team to reproduce in customer sites.

I'll add a brief scope doc to the shared Mural and drop a DocuSign for the SOW acceptance for your legal team. Camila — can you surface training SLAs (recording cadence, LMS upload timing) so Amira has clarity?

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Amira Hassan <amira@convergence.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: tech@convergence.ai, partners@convergence.ai
Date: 2028-04-02T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence + Redwood: onboarding plan and enablement materials

Thanks Irene and Jonas — this is great and aligns with our expectations. A few clarifications:

- We will provide a sanitized 1,200-row CSV and a 12-prompt set by Apr 15.
- No PO required for the initial enablement sprint; legal prefers DocuSign signature on the SOW and then we'll attach the PO for subsequent engagements.
- White-label: we'd prefer Redwood collateral to be co-branded, not white-labelled; please include that in the participant materials.

Availability: the PS + SE cohort are available Apr 22–26 for sandbox drops, and Apr 29 for the workshop.

Adding our technical lead (forwarded):

On Tue, Apr 2, 2028 at 13:42 Tech Team <tech@convergence.ai> wrote:
> Hi Redwood team — I will be the tech lead for onboarding. For the lab we will need a simple S3-compatible location to drop the dataset and a short runbook for ingest.
> Cheers,
> Marco (tech@convergence.ai)

We will sign the DocuSign link once you send it.

Best,
Amira

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amira Hassan <amira@convergence.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-03T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Convergence + Redwood: onboarding plan and enablement materials

Perfect — thanks for the prompt responses, Amira. Summary and immediate next steps from Redwood:

1) Jonas will provision the 2-GPU pod for Apr 22 sandbox runs.
2) Camila will draft the 2-hour workshop agenda and co-branded slide deck; she will also add the materials to our partner LMS and share access by Apr 25.
3) I will send the DocuSign for the SOW today (link: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456) and an initial calendar invite for Apr 22 09:00 PT — please confirm attendees.
4) Action items for Convergence: share sanitized dataset + prompt set by Apr 15; confirm final attendee list and whether any special network/VPC peering is required.

I'll also create a mutual action plan in Google Docs and share it (link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c--convergence-mutual-action-plan).

If that looks good, I'll lock the calendar and send a meeting agenda.

Thanks — Irene
Director, Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.ai
